capabilities: Import a paper from an arXiv link, IEEE Xplore link, or DOI
Save the PDF and main figure into a per-paper folder
Generate Quick Read or Deep Read reading outlines
Apply a custom Markdown template to new paper notes
Translate abstracts into Chinese through an OpenAI-compatible provider
extras: Basic imports work without an API key; translation is off by default and the chosen provider may charge for requests. Requires Obsidian desktop 1.15.0 or later. Figure size limit 20 MB, PDF limit 80 MB. Chinese usage documentation is available.
problem: Getting a paper into Obsidian means copying the abstract, downloading the PDF and figure, and writing a reading outline by hand for each paper.

relations.evidence: look up an open copy through Semantic Scholar
Turn an arXiv link, an IEEE Xplore link, or a DOI into a reading note

summary: Turns an arXiv or IEEE Xplore link or DOI into a reading note with abstract, PDF, main figure, and a fill-in reading outline.
